review.basis: Independent solve: years of edema/hypertension plus nocturia, severe anemia and bleeding tendency establish chronic renal failure; new impaired consciousness is compatible with uremic encephalopathy. Serum creatinine is therefore the most direct first listed test to confirm renal failure severity. Current K7 KP14 owns CKD renal-function staging with Scr as source-specific precision; KP09 owns uremic encephalopathy/system manifestations and KP13 owns the chronicity evidence.

review.basis: Independent solve: the correct surgical statement is that type II/III gastric ulcer subtotal gastrectomy removes at least about 60% of the stomach. Current D10 KP21 explicitly preserves the Study range as distal gastrectomy >2/3–3/4 while also noting the source wording of approximately 60%, and it separately states Billroth II uses a 3–4 cm anastomosis with lower recurrence.

review.basis: Independent solve: despite mixed root/long-tract examination clues, the decisive symptom cluster is position-provoked vertigo with transient drop attacks and visual blurring, which identifies vertebral-artery cervical spondylosis among the offered options. Current O4 KP05 explicitly maps drop attacks, vertigo and blurred vision to the vertebral-artery type; KP09 is supporting evidence for the mixed root/cord signs in the stem.
